accepted.s: Which one of the following schemes is intended for meritorious girl students studying in Classes 9 to 12 and is implemented with the Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti?
accepted.x: Vigyan Jyoti targets meritorious girl students in Classes 9 to 12 and is implemented with the Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti.
accepted.tq: Identify the scheme from its precise target group and implementing organisation.
accepted.sec: DST schemes for women and inclusion in STEM → target group

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding DST schemes for women and inclusion in STEM:
1. KIRAN is an umbrella programme for women scientists, including those returning after a career break.
2. WISE supports women's re-entry and career advancement in STEM.
3. GATI seeks gender equity through structural reforms in academic and research institutions.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. KIRAN, WISE and GATI address women scientists, career advancement and institutional gender equity respectively.
accepted.tq: Check each scheme against its distinctive beneficiary or institutional purpose.
accepted.sec: DST schemes for women and inclusion in STEM → target group

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below the lists:

List-I (Scheme)
A. CURIE
B. WiSLP
C. SEED
D. GATI

List-II (Focus)
1. Early- and mid-career women scientists with the British Council
2. Gender equity through structural reforms in institutions
3. State-of-the-art research facilities for 22 Women PG Colleges
4. STI Hubs for SC/ST communities

Codes:
accepted.x: CURIE relates to research facilities for 22 Women PG Colleges; WiSLP works with early- and mid-career women scientists and the British Council; SEED has established STI Hubs for SC/ST communities; GATI promotes institutional gender equity.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair and eliminate codes with mismatched scheme purposes.
accepted.sec: DST schemes for women and inclusion in STEM → target group

accepted.s: The WiSLP scheme is primarily associated with which of the following groups?
o: Meritorious boys studying in Classes 9 to 12
Universities selected on the basis of publication output
Women scientists at the early and mid-career stages
accepted.x: WiSLP, or Women in Space and Allied Science Leadership Programme, is meant for early- and mid-career women scientists and is associated with the British Council.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely related women-focused schemes by their career stage.
accepted.sec: DST schemes for women and inclusion in STEM → target group

accepted.s: The SEED programme has established 52 STI Hubs primarily for which of the following groups?
o: Meritorious girl students in Classes 9 to 12
Women scientists returning after career breaks
accepted.x: SEED, or Science for Equity, Empowerment and Development, has established 52 STI Hubs for SC/ST communities.
accepted.tq: Link the numerical detail with the programme's specific inclusion target.
accepted.sec: DST schemes for women and inclusion in STEM → target group

accepted.s: SATHI is the acronym for:
o: Shared Analytical Technology for Higher Innovation
Science and Technology Assistance for Higher Institutions
accepted.x: SATHI stands for Sophisticated Analytical & Technical Help Institutes.
accepted.tq: Test the exact official expansion of a science-infrastructure acronym.
accepted.sec: DST research-infrastructure schemes → full form + purpose

accepted.s: Which one of the following best describes the purpose of SATHI?
o: Providing shared high-end analytical instruments to academia, start-ups and MSMEs
Providing research grants to universities according to publication output
Awarding school students for innovation and providing PhD fellowships
Upgrading only the buildings of women postgraduate colleges
accepted.x: SATHI provides shared access to high-end analytical instruments for academia, start-ups and MSMEs.
accepted.tq: Apply the scheme's purpose to the institutions that would use its facilities.
accepted.sec: DST research-infrastructure schemes → full form + purpose

accepted.s: FIST refers to which of the following?
o: Fund for Institutional Support to Technology
Fund for Improvement of S&T Infrastructure in universities and higher educational institutions
Facility for Innovation and Science Technology
accepted.x: FIST means Fund for Improvement of S&T Infrastructure in universities and higher educational institutions.
accepted.tq: Use the exact expansion rather than a look-alike interpretation of the acronym.
accepted.sec: DST research-infrastructure schemes → full form + purpose

accepted.s: The principal purpose of FIST is to:
o: Upgrade laboratories and equipment of academic departments
Support women scientists returning after a career break
Rank universities on their publication output
Establish STI Hubs for SC/ST communities
accepted.x: FIST is intended for upgrading laboratories and equipment in departments of universities and higher educational institutions.
accepted.tq: Separate infrastructure-upgrade schemes from fellowships, rankings and inclusion programmes.
accepted.sec: DST research-infrastructure schemes → full form + purpose

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes INSPIRE?
o: Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research; it draws young talent into science from school awards to PhD fellowships and faculty posts
Institute Network for Science and Professional Research Education; it provides shared instruments to MSMEs
Innovation Support Programme for Research Equipment; it upgrades departmental laboratories
Indian Network for Scientific Promotion and Research Excellence; it provides only university publication grants
accepted.x: INSPIRE stands for Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research and covers a continuum from school awards to PhD fellowships and faculty posts to attract young talent to science.
accepted.tq: Use the full-form-and-purpose combination to reject swapped institutional functions.
accepted.sec: DST research-infrastructure schemes → full form + purpose

accepted.s: PURSE is associated with which one of the following purposes?
o: Career advancement of women scientists in STEM
Research grants to universities ranked on publication output
Laboratory and equipment upgrades of departments
Shared high-end analytical instruments for start-ups and MSMEs
accepted.x: PURSE, or Promotion of University Research and Scientific Excellence, provides research grants to universities ranked on publication output.
accepted.tq: Match the scheme with its distinctive basis for support.
accepted.sec: DST research-infrastructure schemes → full form + purpose

accepted.s: National Technology Day is observed on 11 May to mark which of the following events?
o: The discovery of the Raman Effect in 1928
The establishment of the Department of Science and Technology
The launch of the INSPIRE programme
accepted.x: National Technology Day on 11 May commemorates the Pokhran-II nuclear tests conducted in 1998.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the technology observance from the separately commemorated science observance.
accepted.sec: National Science Day and National Technology Day

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding India's innovation indicators:
1. India was ranked 38th in the Global Innovation Index 2025.
2. India ranked sixth in the world in patent filing activity according to WIPO 2023.
3. India occupied the 49th position out of 133 in the Network Readiness Index 2024.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: India ranked 38th in GII 2025, sixth globally in WIPO 2023 patent filing activity, and 49th of 133 in the Network Readiness Index 2024.
accepted.tq: Check each ranking independently before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Innovation rankings - GII, patents

accepted.s: According to WIPO 2023 data, India's position in global patent filing activity was:
accepted.x: India ranked sixth in the world in patent filing activity according to WIPO 2023.
accepted.tq: Match the rank with the correct indicator rather than with a similarly reported index.
accepted.sec: Innovation rankings - GII, patents

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents India's performance in the Network Readiness Index?
accepted.x: India ranked 49th out of 133 in the Network Readiness Index 2024, up from 79th in 2019.
accepted.tq: Track both the latest rank and the direction of change across years.
accepted.sec: Innovation rankings - GII, patents

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding the Draft National Health Research Policy, 2026 is correct?
o: It was approved as the RDI Scheme on 1 July 2025.
It is the fifth national science and technology policy prepared by the Department of Science and Technology.
It focuses exclusively on patent filing activity and innovation rankings.
It is the first unified health-research framework and was prepared by the Department of Health Research.
accepted.x: The Draft National Health Research Policy, 2026, prepared by the Department of Health Research, is described as the first unified health-research framework.
accepted.tq: Identify the responsible department and distinguish a draft policy from a separate approved scheme.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The Draft National Health Research Policy, 2026 proposes raising public health-research spending from 0.024% of GDP to which levels by 2037 and 2047 respectively?
accepted.x: The draft policy proposes increasing public health-research spending from 0.024% of GDP to 0.072% by 2037 and 0.15% by 2047.
accepted.tq: Preserve the chronological order of the two target percentages.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which governance arrangement is proposed under the Draft National Health Research Policy, 2026?
o: Single-tier governance under the Department of Science and Technology
accepted.x: The Draft National Health Research Policy, 2026 proposes a three-tier governance structure.
accepted.tq: Identify the policy architecture from the exact structural descriptor.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Arrange the following national science and technology policy milestones in chronological order:
A. STIP 2020
B. SPR 1958
C. Science and Technology Policy 1983
D. Science and Technology Policy 2003
accepted.x: The correct sequence is SPR 1958, Science and Technology Policy 1983, Science and Technology Policy 2003 and STIP 2020.
accepted.tq: Fix the first and last milestones, then place the intermediate policies by year.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about national science and technology policies is correct?
o: STIP 2020 preceded SPR 1958 and was the second national policy.
SPR 1958 was the fifth policy, whereas STIP 2020 was the first.
SPR 1958 was the first national science and technology policy, whereas STIP 2020 was the fifth.
Both SPR 1958 and STIP 2020 were the first national science and technology policies.
accepted.x: SPR 1958 represents the first national science and technology policy, while STIP 2020 represents the fifth.
accepted.tq: Use the first-versus-last comparison to reject the reversed chronology trap.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The 2% GERD goal has been missed under every national science and technology policy.
2. Grants under the ANRF have been criticised for being skewed towards IITs.
3. The criticism regarding ANRF grants concerns their distribution rather than the target of public health-research spending.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The 2% GERD target has not been achieved under any policy, and ANRF grants have been criticised for favouring IITs; this is a distributional criticism distinct from health-research spending targets.
accepted.tq: Separate two contemporary criticisms that concern different policy instruments.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The DST-STI Hub at Sri Padmavati Mahila Visvavidyalayam, Tirupati, is associated with which focus?
o: Shared high-end instruments for MSMEs in urban clusters
Patent filing activity and global innovation rankings
Sericulture, agriculture and livelihoods for SC/ST women
accepted.x: The DST-STI Hub at SPMVV, Tirupati focuses on sericulture, agriculture and livelihoods for SC/ST women through a three-year project.
accepted.tq: Apply the location-specific institutional detail to identify the project focus.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The DST-STI Hub at SPMVV, Tirupati, has been described as a project of what duration?
accepted.x: The DST-STI Hub at SPMVV, Tirupati is a three-year project.
accepted.tq: Test the precise duration attached to the Andhra Pradesh-specific initiative.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
